source: JRA-VAN JV-Data specification Ver.4.9.01 and JRA-VAN developer support examples
correction: V1 incorrectly described WH body-weight change code 000 as zero kg change. Official specification says 000 means no previous race. Numeric zero must not be inferred from code 000.

change_semantics.001-998: valid absolute kg difference with sign field
change_semantics.blank: first start; also blank on scratch

facts.initial_state_behavior: Initial weather/track state may be delivered with announcement code 00000000 and change-id 1. Since that record has no usable official announcement timestamp, a prediction snapshot may use it only if the complete 0B14 capture itself was acquired by the snapshot; source_time_basis becomes LOCAL_ACQUISITION and source time equals capture time.

bulk_state_note: Realtime meeting-change information can be withdrawn after provision. For 0B14 bulk polling, reconstruct prediction state only from the latest complete capture acquired by the prediction snapshot; do not carry forward an event absent from that later complete capture.
